walkthroughs.body_html:
Comparative Study (HL Extension) — a core area of Art & Design.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Comparative Study (HL Extension) brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Comparative Study (HL Extension).

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Who developed iconological method in Studies in Iconology 1939?
options: Heinrich Wolfflin
Erwin Panofsky
Alois Riegl
Aby Warburg

mcqs.q: Whose 1998 Art and Agency treats artworks as social agents?
options: Bourdieu
Gell
Baxandall
Belting
Art that does not depict any recognisable object - exploring form, colour, and line directly.
Art that looks 'a bit like' something but not exactly.
Art that doesn't represent any country.
It is a study of plumbing.

mcqs.q: What is the significance of Duchamp's 'Fountain'?
options: The space between letters.
It challenged the definition of art - the artist's choice, not their skill, becomes the artwork.
It is a study of plumbing.
It demonstrated his sculpting ability.
A whole typeface that looks formal.
The small projecting line at the end of letter strokes.
The space between letters.
It is a study of plumbing.
